[0] Although the launch of iOS 27 has attracted much attention, Apple also released a new software update for AirPods this month. This update brings a long-awaited feature to supported AirPods models: custom EQ.

[1] AirPods Software Details

[2] The latest AirPods firmware version numbers are 9A350 for AirPods 5, and 9A348 for the following other models. This update applies to the following AirPods models:

  • [3] AirPods Pro 3
  • [4] AirPods 4
  • [5] AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation)
  • [6] AirPods 5
  • [7] AirPods 5 (with Wireless Charging Case)
  • [8] AirPods Pro 2 (Lightning and USB-C versions)
  • [9] AirPods Max 2

[10] Apple says that as long as the AirPods are charging and within Bluetooth range of a connected iPhone, iPad or Mac that is connected to Wi-Fi, the firmware update will install automatically. You can check the firmware version of your AirPods in the Settings app on your iPhone.

[11] Custom EQ Feature Lands on AirPods

[12] After installing the AirPods firmware update, you'll find a long-awaited new feature in the Settings app: custom EQ.

[13] With new custom EQ controls, you have more flexibility to fine-tune the sound of your AirPods. In the Settings app, you can adjust the bass, mid, and treble of your AirPods yourself.

[14] Apple explains: "AirPods are designed and built by Apple to faithfully reproduce the sound of music, TV shows and movies, as well as phone calls. If you prefer a different sound profile, you can customise how your AirPods play any audio."

[15] While adjusting custom EQ settings, you can play Apple Music songs directly within the Settings app to hear the effect of your adjustments in real time.

[16] This feature isn't the most advanced equaliser on the market—it's just a basic three-band system. But for AirPods users, this long-overdue feature is finally being opened up by Apple—even though most people will likely continue using the default settings.

[17] You can find the new custom EQ feature in the Settings app under the AirPods section, in the "Audio and Routing" menu. All AirPods equipped with the H2 chip support this feature, including AirPods Pro 2, AirPods Pro 3, AirPods 4 and AirPods Max 2.

[18] Other New Features iOS 27 Brings to AirPods

[19] Here are other new features iOS 27 brings to AirPods:

  • [20] Redesigned Settings App: iOS 27 has redesigned the AirPods interface in the Settings app. Controls have been rearranged, with separate menus for hearing health, Find My, live translation, and more.
  • [21] Adaptive Audio Slider: A new slider has been added in the Settings app to further fine-tune Adaptive Audio mode.
  • [22] GymKit: Although GymKit has been around for several years, it has always required pairing with an Apple Watch. As my colleague Zac mentioned, iOS 27 brings the full GymKit experience to iPhone and AirPods Pro 3.
  • [23] Precision Finding: You can now use the Find My app on your Apple Watch in conjunction with Precision Finding to locate your AirPods Pro 3.
  • [24] Siri AI: When used with a compatible iPhone, AirPods can interact with Siri AI.

[25] Summary

[26] Which new AirPods feature are you most looking forward to trying? Will you give the new custom EQ feature a go? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
